nbb1fb8e677.summary: Experts expect China to assist North Korea in avoiding economic collapse despite ongoing sanctions and the pandemic.
nbb1fb8e677.why: North Korea's economic stability affects regional trade and geopolitical risk in East Asia.

ndc651cce59.headline: Return of Inflation as Economic Activity Revives in Saudi Arabia
ndc651cce59.summary: Saudi Arabia anticipates a return of inflation in the second half of 2020 due to COVID-19 economic pressures, reduced commercial activity, and lower consumer spending.
ndc651cce59.why: Inflation trends in Saudi Arabia affect monetary policy, consumer purchasing power, and investment in the region's largest economy.
